posts.text: As the Trump administration attacks the social fabric of the United States, the continued peaceful resistance of Americans will turn the tide against democratic backsliding. ampr.gs/3PKJnuQ

The Trump administration is cracking down on political dissent, but Americans won't stand down. From the Boston Tea Party to No Kings Day, peaceful protest is one of the most patriotic things we can do. ✊

Thanks to the Trump administration's chaotic policies, American manufacturers are already struggling with higher costs and the difficulty of managing supply chains. Now, manufacturers must face the economic shock of Trump's war of choice in Iran. ampr.gs/4dX1bNf
It's been nearly 1 year since Trump's "Liberation Day" and small businesses are still feeling the squeeze from his tariffs.

Even if Trump were to end the war in Iran tomorrow, the "tail" associated with the war’s devastation is likely to keep prices high, consumer confidence low, and the future uncertain. 

And as with most of the administration's actions, it'll be American workers and American small businesses paying the price. ampr.gs/4dX1bNf
